channel.title: Slip Three
channel.description: Ten transmissions. One voice, broadcasting from open water on a six-second satellite window, counting down to something. New transmission every Tuesday, 03:00 UTC.

item.title: The Zero Node
item.description: Six seconds of window, four times a day. He spent one of them on you. Transmission 01 of 10. Attached: MCA-CTL-0314-RAW (partial). Station CQ-03. Read from 0x4E1C20. Everything either side of it is tide.
